limitations: C only proves cross-session admission; it does not prove intra-session distinction by action, reason or tool identity.

The historical inbox has no ACK, cursor, expiry or dead-letter mechanism. The 20 historical rows remain queued. The harness artifact was queued at 13:24:10 and delivered at 13:30:17 (367.268 s), showing that delivery can be delayed even when no event is lost.
The harness artifact is a real deny in the current session, caused by the first launch command text. It is excluded from A/B and C; it executed no command and did not alter protected state.

The current session coalescer entry was reset by the subsequent prompt at 14:55:53.035Z; the artifact remains visible as a synthetic message, but the current session no longer appears in the notifications state.
